prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young man with striking blue hair stands center frame in a futuristic, ultra-modern white interior, reminiscent of a high-concept art museum or science fiction setting. He wears a loose, dark navy sweater with a bright blue accent patch and glossy, black vinyl pants, exuding a bold, avant-garde fashion sense. His expression is intense and focused, as if mid-performance or deep in thought. Flanking him on either side are two surreal, headless figures dressed in flowing black garments; instead of heads, they have glowing white Wi-Fi symbols floating above their necks, adding a digital, conceptual twist to the scene. The background features sweeping, curved white architecture with large glass windows, bathed in cool, natural light that enhances the clean, minimalist aesthetic. The overall color palette is dominated by crisp whites, deep blacks, and electric blues, creating a visually striking contrast. The composition is wide and cinematic, with a slight low angle that emphasizes the scale and modernity of the space, while the shallow depth of field keeps the focus on the central figure and his enigmatic companions. The mood is both futuristic and surreal, blending high fashion, digital symbolism, and contemporary art influences.
